note: Sioux County Conservation recreation area a mile east of Sioux Center on B40, opened 2014 around two small lakes with a swimming beach, boat ramp, kayak rental, archery range and prairie trails. The campground lines a diagonal road southwest of the west lake, behind a gravel road and a belt of shoreline trees. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm 37 sites (20/30/50A, some water and sewer), 34 FCFS and 3 full-hookup sites online, $22-26 at the site and $31 online, showers, flush toilets, dump, 14-day limit, mid-April to mid-October. The mandatory vehicle pass ($5/day, $20/year) is now in fees.entrance. Not waterfront stands. Pin is ~280 m east of the campground, so a move is given. Phone 712-552-1047.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. On NAIP the two lakes measure about 290 x 210 m (west lake, irregular, ~3.5 ha / ~9 acres) and 130 x 295 m (east lake, ~2 ha / ~5 acres, with the swim beach and boat area), so both are at or above the 5-acre line and count as lakes. But the RV pads sit along a diagonal road SW of the west lake, and between them and the water are a gravel road, a grassy ditch strip and a continuous belt of shoreline trees, about 90-115 m for the west pads. The few eastern pads (where the full-hookup sites appear to be) are ~60 m from the south shore with the same tree belt between. I found no official photo showing a view through the trees, so there is no lakeview; downgrade rule applied.
PIN MOVE: the stored pin 43.06360,-96.11457 is on the trail and grass loop ~280 m east of the campground. Corrected coordinates for the RV pads: 43.06400,-96.11798.
